Set level result accessors

Source: R/accessors.R
setResultsAccessors.Rd

Return the parts of a RegionSetDE.setResults object beyond its table: the per-region statistics the set level test was computed on, the kind of test and the methods that were run.

Usage

regionStats(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
regionStats(results)

setTestType(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
setTestType(results)

setTestMethods(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
setTestMethods(results)

Arguments

results

RegionSetDE.setResults object returned by testRegionSets or testSetContrast.

Value

regionStats returns a data.frame with one row per region, holding the statistics the set level test read. setTestType returns "set" for testRegionSets and "setContrast" for testSetContrast. setTestMethods returns the names of the tests that were run, for instance "camera" and "fry".

See also

resultsTable, setUniverse, contrastGroups

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

fit <- loadExampleData("fit", verbose = FALSE)
setRes <- testRegionSets(fit, contrast = c("condition", "SHR", "BN"), verbose = FALSE)

setTestType(setRes)
#> [1] "set"
setTestMethods(setRes)
#> [1] "camera" "fry"   
head(regionStats(setRes), 3)
#>       log2FC average.signal       stat stat.distribution df1      df2   p.value
#> 1 -0.4744876       3.098695 -0.4077872                 f   1 18.94543 0.6880013
#> 2 -1.6911510       3.141973 -1.5289174                 f   1 18.73556 0.1429931
#> 3  0.1328366       3.273341  0.1001436                 f   1 18.45274 0.9213104
#>       region.set    region.id region.key.plain seqnames start   end width
#> 1 promoterNonCpG region_00012     region_00012    chr12 26988 27987  1000
#> 2 promoterNonCpG region_00017     region_00017    chr12 39449 40448  1000
#> 3 promoterNonCpG region_00019     region_00019    chr12 44116 45115  1000
